reviewed_snapshot_reconstruction.method: All current relation elements were checked against the reviewed OSM base timestamp. This was the only later element. The baseline retains the version 1 coordinates from the retained OSM node history.
reviewed_snapshot_reconstruction.reason: The temporary reviewed source directory was removed after review. A new collection found one OSM edit made after the reviewed snapshot.
